speaker: narrator
text: Grey fruit hangs in hard knots on pale bark. Something is badly wrong with them, but you would not know where to begin. A gardener might. There is a keeper somewhere under the nearest bough.

speaker: narrator
text: The cavern roof has fallen away, and the whole sky stands open above you. It is lovely, and it means nothing to you yet. Ask the keeper of the orchard what she wants read in it.
